title: Folklore: The Affliction
publicSourceReferences: Greenbrier Games Official Rulebook & Story Books
BGG Community Forums & Campaign Play Logs (r/boardgames, BGG Folklore threads)

milestones.title: Shadows Gather
milestones.description: The heroes complete their first story, uncovering the dark forces seeping into the land and the nature of the affliction threatening the innocent.

milestones.title: Darkness Deepens
milestones.description: Three stories in, the full breadth of the affliction is revealed and the heroes grow in power, facing increasingly dangerous and supernatural foes.

milestones.title: Edge of Despair
milestones.description: The penultimate stories bring the heroes to the brink, as the source of the affliction prepares its final, terrible move against the realm.

milestones.title: The Affliction Ends
milestones.description: The heroes confront the ultimate evil behind the affliction in a desperate final stand to save the land from eternal darkness.
